title: MI62001: Bulk Materials Handling
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Properties of bulk material vis-a-vis different bulk handling operations;
Classification of bulk material transportation systems, Design, operation and
maintenance aspects of mine hoist, belt conveyors and chain conveyors,
Hydraulic and pneumatic conveying; Stacking, blending and reclaiming of bulk
materials; Automation and online monitoring of bulk material handling system.
Design of storage system: Silos, bins and bunkers; Rapid loading system, Merrygo-round system.
